svg.font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Source Sans 3', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Three panels, each a sphere. Panel I: three violet arrows e₁, e₂, e₃, mutually perpendicular; three magenta discs are the planes I_x, I_y, I_z they span in pairs. Panel II: the amber point leaves the north pole N, tilts by θ along a meridian and then twists by φ along the dashed latitude circle, stopping at the target. Panel III: each of the six rational axes carries a cyan 45° cap at both ends, twelve in all, covering the whole sphere; a green LEAN ✓ tag sits at the bottom.

svg.text: III six rational axes cover it
